title: Knowledge and Priming Architecture Design
objective: Design the first implementation slice of Josie's Knowledge and Priming layer using the existing Josie architecture. Preserve SQLite and structured memory as authoritative, preserve existing retrieval, and add explicit task-specific priming rather than replacing current systems.

jobs.title: Design Knowledge and Priming Integration
jobs.objective: Inspect the current Josie repository, especially existing memory, retrieval, Supervisor, prompt compilation, receipts, and relevant canonical architecture. Create docs/KNOWLEDGE_PRIMING_DESIGN.md describing a minimal implementation design for a Knowledge and Priming layer. The design must use this flow: raw evidence/source history -> extracted and provenance-linked memory claims -> organized canonical knowledge -> task-specific priming/context assembly -> Supervisor/worker. Raw ChatGPT or Gemini takeouts must remain evidence rather than direct prompt context. Existing retrieval must be preserved and combined with explicit priming. SQLite and structured data remain authoritative; human-readable Markdown mirrors may be generated for inspection but are not authoritative. The design must identify where priming occurs before prompt compilation, how task-specific priming manifests select minimal relevant knowledge, and how Supervisor receipts can record the priming bundle, sources, provenance, and a reproducible bundle hash. Do not implement runtime code in this mission. Base the design on repository evidence and clearly identify any unresolved decisions rather than inventing them.
jobs.first_action: Inspect the existing repository architecture and relevant canonical documentation before writing the design.

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('docs/KNOWLEDGE_PRIMING_DESIGN.md'); s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'); required=['raw evidence','provenance','canonical knowledge','priming','Supervisor','retrieval','SQLite','bundle hash']; missing=[x for x in required if x.lower() not in s.lower()]; assert not missing, f'Missing required concepts: {missing}'; assert len(s.strip()) >= 1500, 'Design is too short to be substantive'
